title: Bank of America Warns $1T AI Investment Mirrors Classic Bust Cycle
summary:
Surging capital costs and a drop in service pricing are signaling a potential market correction in artificial intelligence, Bank of America warned. The bank identified intensifying competition and a pattern of unsustainable spending as key indicators that the sector is currently mirroring a classic boom-and-bust cycle.

The total investment in AI has reached approximately $1 trillion, but the bank cautions that this growth may be unsustainable. According to its analysis, the combination of high expenditure and falling prices could lead the current AI investment surge to end in a major downturn or market collapse.
